segments.text: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.
His brethren therefore said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus’ brothers
segments.text: Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

segments.speaker: Jesus’ brothers
segments.text: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
For neither did his brethren believe in him.
Then Jesus said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
¶ But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said,

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: Where is he?
And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: He is a good man:
others said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
¶ Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
And the Jews marvelled, saying,

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
Jesus answered them, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
The people answered and said,

segments.speaker: The crowd
segments.text: Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
Jesus answered and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
Then said some of them of Jerusalem,

segments.speaker: Some of the people of Jerusalem
segments.text: Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

segments.speaker: Some of the people of Jerusalem
segments.text: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

segments.speaker: Some of the people of Jerusalem
segments.text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
And many of the people believed on him,

segments.speaker: Many in the crowd
segments.text: and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
¶ The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
Then said the Jews among themselves,

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
(But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
¶ Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said,

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: Of a truth this is the Prophet.
Others said,

segments.speaker: Other People
segments.text: This is the Christ.
But some said,

segments.speaker: Still others
segments.text: Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

segments.speaker: Still others
segments.text: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
So there was a division among the people because of him.
And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
¶ Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them,

segments.speaker: The chief priests and Pharisees
segments.text: Why have ye not brought him?
The officers answered,

segments.speaker: The officers
segments.text: Never man spake like this man.
Then answered them the Pharisees,

segments.speaker: The Pharisees
segments.text: Are ye also deceived?

segments.speaker: The Pharisees
segments.text: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

segments.speaker: The Pharisees
segments.text: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

segments.speaker: Nicodemus
segments.text: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
They answered and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The Pharisees
segments.text: Art thou also of Galilee?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
And every man went unto his own house.
